description: Free anonymous or authenticated append-only log for an action performed outside Zambo. The entry is recorded as an agent-reported claim; Zambo does not claim it ran or observed the action. Limited to 20 calls per IP per day on the free tier. Required arguments: job_id, tool_name, executor_identity.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

executor_identity.description: Agent, client, or local executor that reported the action.

external_executor.description: External server or executor name when relevant.

inputs.description: Optional local input object. It is redacted and hashed, then discarded.

job_id.description: Stable job or session identifier shared by the agent.

redacted_inputs_hash.description: Hash of redacted inputs. Raw inputs are never stored.

tool_name.description: Tool or action name reported by the agent.

name: journal_log

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.

title: Journal log
